MERGE INTO REVRYZE.RAW.GHL_OPPORTUNITIES t
USING (
  SELECT
    'health_hax' AS CLIENT_ID,

    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.opportunity_id}}', 'null'), '') AS OPPORTUNITY_ID,
    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.location_id}}', 'null'), '') AS LOCATION_ID,
    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.contact_id}}', 'null'), '') AS CONTACT_ID,

    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.pipeline_id}}', 'null'), '') AS PIPELINE_ID,
    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.pipeline_stage_id}}', 'null'), '') AS PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(REPLACE('{{$json.pipeline_name}}', '''', ''''''), 'null'), '') AS PIPELINE_NAME,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(REPLACE('{{$json.pipeline_stage_name}}', '''', ''''''), 'null'), '') AS PIPELINE_STAGE_NAME,

    NULLIF(NULLIF(REPLACE('{{$json.status}}', '''', ''''''), 'null'), '') AS STATUS,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(REPLACE('{{$json.name}}', '''', ''''''), 'null'), '') AS NAME,

    TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.monetary_value}}', 'null'), ''), 18, 2) AS MONETARY_VALUE,

    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.created_at_str}}', 'null'), '') AS CREATED_AT_STR,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.created_at_str}}', 'null'), '')) AS CREATED_AT_TS,

    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.updated_at_str}}', 'null'), '') AS UPDATED_AT_STR,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.updated_at_str}}', 'null'), '')) AS UPDATED_AT_TS,

    NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.closed_at_str}}', 'null'), '') AS CLOSED_AT_STR,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.closed_at_str}}', 'null'), '')) AS CLOSED_AT_TS,

    TRY_PARSE_JSON('{{$json.raw}}') AS RAW,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.pulled_at_ts}}', 'null'), '')) AS PULLED_AT_TS
) s

ON t.OPPORTUNITY_ID = s.OPPORTUNITY_ID

WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  LOCATION_ID = s.LOCATION_ID,
  CONTACT_ID = s.CONTACT_ID,
  PIPELINE_ID = s.PIPELINE_ID,
  PIPELINE_STAGE_ID = s.PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
  PIPELINE_NAME = s.PIPELINE_NAME,
  PIPELINE_STAGE_NAME = s.PIPELINE_STAGE_NAME,
  STATUS = s.STATUS,
  NAME = s.NAME,
  MONETARY_VALUE = s.MONETARY_VALUE,
  UPDATED_AT_STR = s.UPDATED_AT_STR,
  UPDATED_AT_TS = s.UPDATED_AT_TS,
  CLOSED_AT_STR = s.CLOSED_AT_STR,
  CLOSED_AT_TS = s.CLOSED_AT_TS,
  RAW = s.RAW,
  PULLED_AT_TS = s.PULLED_AT_TS

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  CLIENT_ID,
  OPPORTUNITY_ID,
  LOCATION_ID,
  CONTACT_ID,
  PIPELINE_ID,
  PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
  PIPELINE_NAME,
  PIPELINE_STAGE_NAME,
  STATUS,
  NAME,
  MONETARY_VALUE,
  CREATED_AT_STR,
  CREATED_AT_TS,
  UPDATED_AT_STR,
  UPDATED_AT_TS,
  CLOSED_AT_STR,
  CLOSED_AT_TS,
  RAW,
  PULLED_AT_TS
)
VALUES (
  s.CLIENT_ID,
  s.OPPORTUNITY_ID,
  s.LOCATION_ID,
  s.CONTACT_ID,
  s.PIPELINE_ID,
  s.PIPELINE_STAGE_ID,
  s.PIPELINE_NAME,
  s.PIPELINE_STAGE_NAME,
  s.STATUS,
  s.NAME,
  s.MONETARY_VALUE,
  s.CREATED_AT_STR,
  s.CREATED_AT_TS,
  s.UPDATED_AT_STR,
  s.UPDATED_AT_TS,
  s.CLOSED_AT_STR,
  s.CLOSED_AT_TS,
  s.RAW,
  s.PULLED_AT_TS
);
